fightSong.title: Let Freedom Ring
fightSong.lyrics: From South Philly to the Liberty Bell / We ring it loud and we ring it well / No one likes us, we don't care / Bell-Ringers flying through the air!

stadium.name: The Belfry
stadium.tradition: The Crack Heard 'Round the World — a 2-ton replica Liberty Bell is rung after every score. It's intentionally cracked. If we win, the opposing team's mascot gets 'tossed' from the bell tower (a dummy, relax).

fanCulture.description: They booed Santa once and they're proud of it. After every turnover, 70,000 people yell 'YOU RANG?' They throw batteries (not really anymore, it's 2026). They will fight you over cheesesteak semantics.
fanCulture.tailgate: Starts at 6am. Ends when the cops come. Features cheesesteaks, soft pretzels, and unlicensed bell-ringing.
fanCulture.luckyCharm: Mini Liberty Bell with a crack

rivalries.name: The Turnpike Toll
rivalries.narrative: Philly vs NYC Cabbies. It's 95 miles of pure hatred. They think they're the big city, we think they're soft. We meet in the middle to fight.

rivalries.name: The Liberty Bowl
rivalries.narrative: DC Filibusters talk, we ring. It's founding fathers vs people who actually work. They filibuster, we finish.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: RING IT UP! First down Philadelphia!

cityFlavor: We invented America and then got mad about it. Underdogs forever, even when we're favored. We boo because we care.
